contract: Share heartbeat versions 0 and 1 join at epoch 0 and leave at epoch -1. Version 2 is refused. Describe reports the group epoch, assignment epoch, and negotiated version.
Share partitions stay uniquely owned. A member epoch older than the issued epoch is fenced. Reopen restores the epochs and the remaining member.
Streams heartbeat version 0 assigns active tasks without overlap and gives a second member standby copies of the other member's tasks. Version 1 is refused.
A different streams topology epoch stores nothing. A static rejoin at epoch -2 replaces the previous member id. Reopen restores the assignment epoch.
limits: This is not the ShareGroupHeartbeat, ShareGroupDescribe, StreamsGroupHeartbeat, or StreamsGroupDescribe RPC.
Streams heartbeat is the Kafka 4.1.2 version 0 profile. Share heartbeat versions 0 and 1 share the membership fields and are not pinned to Apache response bytes.
The journals are the local PLSHR001 and PLSTR001 snapshots.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
